dogecoin.text:
Global access to markets+info enables global wealth creation

If it has to be done via $DOGE $GME $AMC then so be it

Every herd-trade brings about a new wave of intelligent innovators ready to push crypto (& technology) forward

The bold will naturally seek information asymmetry

Happy for people who made money on $DOGE $GME $AMC and so on

But true wealth is not made following the herd

Information asymmetry still is and always will be the edge for genuine wealth creation

Go where the crowd isn’t

You’re a fool if you’re constantly following the herd
